notes:
Summary: Enterprise risk analytics team evaluating Dedicated capacity for low-latency reranking and analyst assistant. Heavy emphasis on predictable throughput and documented SLA. Primary ask: reserved GPU planning for sustained batch scoring (overnight) + sub-100ms p95 for short chat queries during market hours.

Recent interactions: intro call 2026-02-12 (AE), architecture deep-dive 2026-02-20 (SE) — reviewed networking requirements and VPC peering. Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-25. Redwood provided initial sizing + cost estimates 2026-02-28. Legal sent first-pass SLA redlines 2026-03-03. POC kickoff targeted 2026-03-08.

Technical constraints / asks: 
- Workloads: reranking for real-time trade signal pipelines, embeddings for document search, chat assistant for risk analysts, and large nightly batch scoring.
- Latency targets: p50 < 25ms (short token sequences), p95 < 120ms for typical queries; tail for 32k-context long-form generation acceptable up to 400ms but must be predictable.
- Throughput targets: sustained 40k tokens/sec during market hours, burst up to 120k tokens/sec for short windows (2-5m).
- Model preferences: prefer open-weight Llama-3/70B or equivalent Mistral-family; willing to evaluate Redwood-verified variants. Need 32k context support for long docs.
- Quantization: test 8-bit and 4-bit variants. Legal/ML teams worry about quality degradation with aggressive 4-bit. Want concrete perf/quality trade table from Redwood (WER/accuracy/regression on benchmark prompts).
- Batching & KV cache: want strategy for continuous batching with micro-batch sizes tuned by latency SLOs (target micro-batch 4-12 for chat), persistent KV cache for repeated document prefixes, and guidance on cache warmup for nightly batch runs.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial recommendation from Redwood: 8x H100 (80GB) for peak throughput with autoscale for bursts; finance requests alternative sizing using 4x A100-80GB for cost comparison. Need cost/latency/throughput matrix per config.
- Routing/fallback: require policy to route to smaller quantized model variant when dedicated pool degraded; must preserve data isolation (no cross-tenant fallback into hosted pool unless encrypted and contractually allowed).

SLA/Contract notes: 
- Argentum requests 99.95% monthly uptime for Dedicated with financial credits; Redwood standard is 99.9% — current negotiation point.
- Data residency: EU data for EU clients; Redwood must guarantee region pinning and export controls.
- Audit needs: 1-year request log retention, audit logging delivered to customer's SIEM.

POC plan (agreed scope): 
- 2-week Dedicated POC with 4-node H100 reserved baseline + burst pool.
- Run three benchmark suites: short-chat latency, reranking throughput, 32k-context generation quality.
- Deliverables: perf matrix, quantization quality report, recommended reserved GPU count, SLA term sheet draft.

Sales notes / cadence: 
- Champion: CTO (Eleanor Park). Procurement started early due to compliance. Expect procurement lead time 45-60 days post-POC.
- Pricing sensitivity: high; finance wants alternatives for lower ARR (commit options).
- Quote: draft enterprise term sheet under review (drive link above).

Representative quotes from calls: "We need inference that behaves like a utility — predictable and with clear failure modes. We can't have latency spikes during market opens." — Eleanor Park.

Next steps (short): kickoff POC 2026-03-08, bench run 1 by 2026-03-12, legal round 2 by 2026-03-15.
